theatre.title: Chaos Theatre
theatre.subtitle: Break the AI yourself, then watch it survive.

entry.label: Enter the Chaos Theatre
entry.desc: Watch the real review pipeline fail and recover. No account needed.

theatre.disclosure: How this works: the model output is a pre-generated script, but the JSON repair, the semantic gate, the retry ladder and fail-closed are this repository's production code paths. This page is read-only, creates no post, and never calls an external model.

fix-challenge.title: Apply the fix yourself
fix-challenge.subtitle: The same buggy divide, twice: once as written, once with the zero guard.

repaired-json.title: Repair the broken JSON
repaired-json.subtitle: The model returns fenced, truncated JSON the parser cannot finish alone.

empty-placeholder.title: Reject the empty answer
empty-placeholder.subtitle: The first answer is schema-valid but says nothing.

prompt-injection.title: Contain the instruction
prompt-injection.subtitle: The code contains a comment that tells the reviewer to ignore its system prompt.

model-down.title: Survive the dead model
model-down.subtitle: Every model call times out. Nothing is published unreviewed.

theatre.error: Failed to load the traces. Please retry.

fix-challenge.input: The same buggy divide snippet enters the same reviewer used by published posts.
fix-challenge.prompt: The request builder wraps the snippet in per-request nonce delimiters; instructions inside the snippet stay data.
fix-challenge.model: The scripted model returned a substantive review: no zero guard, score 3, severity high.
fix-challenge.validate: Severity is valid and both analysis fields are substantive, so the verdict may be recorded.
fix-challenge.verdict: The buggy snippet earns its 3/10 honestly; apply the fix and the same pipeline re-scores it.

repaired-json.input: The same buggy divide snippet enters the same reviewer used by published posts.
repaired-json.prompt: The request builder wraps the snippet in per-request nonce delimiters.
repaired-json.model: The scripted model returned fenced JSON with a trailing comma and no closing brace.
repaired-json.repair-fail: The repair ladder handles each defect alone; truncation plus a trailing comma exceeds it, so the parser returns a positional error.
repaired-json.retry: The reviewer retries once, sending the broken output and the parser error back to the model.
repaired-json.repair: The corrected object parses cleanly and becomes the recorded result.
repaired-json.validate: Severity is valid and both analysis fields are substantive.
repaired-json.verdict: The repaired output became a real verdict instead of being dropped.

empty-placeholder.input: The same snippet enters the same review pipeline.
empty-placeholder.prompt: The nonce delimiters keep the snippet inside the data region.
empty-placeholder.model: Every schema field is present, but EVALUATE / NONE / FIX carry no analysis.
empty-placeholder.validate: The validity gate refuses placeholders even when the JSON parses.
empty-placeholder.retry: The reviewer retries once with an explicit instruction to produce substantive analysis.
empty-placeholder.verdict: The retry, not the placeholder, is what reaches the post.

prompt-injection.input: The snippet hides a comment that instructs the model to ignore its system prompt and return a perfect score.
prompt-injection.prompt: The nonce delimiters keep the comment inside the data region: it cannot touch the system prompt.
prompt-injection.model: The scripted model returned a low score and stated that the injected comment was treated as data.
prompt-injection.validate: The verdict is substantive and legal; the injection changed neither the schema nor the gate.
prompt-injection.verdict: The review names the injection attempt instead of obeying it.

model-down.input: The same snippet enters the same review pipeline.
model-down.prompt: The nonce delimiters keep the snippet inside the data region.
model-down.model: Each attempt fails against the scripted dead endpoint; the client retries until its budget is spent.
model-down.retry: The reviewer's retry finds the breaker open instead of waiting through another timeout.
model-down.fail-closed: The production listener marks the post FAILED and keeps it out of the published feed.
model-down.reconcile: A scheduled sweep re-dispatches FAILED/REVIEWING posts; the user does not have to do anything.

cf-repaired.label: If the model returned valid JSON
cf-repaired.summary: One clean call: the repair ladder never engages and the verdict records immediately.
cf-repaired.input: The same snippet, the same reviewer.
cf-repaired.model: In this counterfactual the first answer is already valid and substantive.
cf-repaired.validate: The verdict passes the gate on the first attempt.
cf-repaired.verdict: A well-behaved model still goes through the same recording path.

cf-placeholder.label: If the model answered well on attempt 1
cf-placeholder.summary: No placeholder, no reinforced retry: the first answer carries real analysis.
cf-placeholder.input: The same snippet, the same reviewer.
cf-placeholder.model: In this counterfactual there is no placeholder: the first answer carries real analysis.
cf-placeholder.validate: The gate accepts on the first pass.
cf-placeholder.verdict: The reinforced retry is never triggered.

cf-injection.label: If the model obeyed the injection
cf-injection.summary: Score 10, severity low, substantive fields: the gate checks substance, not truth — the nonce delimiters are the real defense.
cf-injection.input: The snippet with the injected comment enters the reviewer unchanged.
cf-injection.model: In this counterfactual the model obeys the injection: score 10, severity low, substantive fields.
cf-injection.validate: Note: the gate checks substance, not truth — a perfect verdict like this passes legally.
cf-injection.verdict: The real defense is the nonce delimiters and the system prompt; the gate is only the last net.

cf-alive.label: If the model had been alive
cf-alive.summary: One healthy call, one valid verdict, no fail-closed: the outage is the only thing that changed.
cf-alive.input: The same snippet, the same reviewer.
cf-alive.model: In this counterfactual the model is alive and one call returns a healthy review.
cf-alive.validate: The gate accepts; no breaker opens.
cf-alive.verdict: The only difference is whether the model was reachable.
